bluf: Hennessey Digital is a North Hollywood law firm SEO and digital marketing agency, founded 2001, owned by Herringbone Digital and still trading under its own brand, selling to mid market firms from personal injury to class action. It has repositioned for AI search: GEO and AIO pages, a free AI Visibility Report, an llms.txt and LinkedIn ads. Horus reads it Favored at +12, best placed for KJ1, most exposed to KJ6; it practises 3 of 3 tested lines. A rival should know: the $1B+ claim and fire us pledge rest on 8 client names with no described work, and Monsoon reads the book as buying on price.
doing:
The positioning line, a law firm SEO and digital marketing agency repositioned for AI search, selling market share and signed cases with a fire us if we underdeliver pledge, decodes to an outcome promise without a public price. The headline claim, $1B+ in revenue and verdicts for law firms, cannot be tested from the record; no case study describes the work.

The menu runs SEO, Law firm GEO and AIO, PPC advertising, Paid media, Content marketing, Conversion rate optimization, Creative services, Web development, SEO consulting and Lead generation. Two capabilities lead at score 3: AI Search / GEO (the meta says built for AI search; law firm GEO pages; the free report on the homepage) and SEO (the title brands an SEO agency; SEO pages per practice area). Content & Digital PR scores 2 on annual law firm data studies issued as press releases, Paid Search 2 on PPC pages for personal injury and criminal defense lawyers. CRO, data, paid social and web score 1; breadth is 8. Proprietary items: a client service platform with Google integrations, the free report, the Annual Lead Form Response Time Study and the Annual Branded Organic Search Traffic Study; no partners.

AI posture is the front door: GEO and AIO services, the free report, AI search webinars and LinkedIn ads. Moves: 2025, the Herringbone Digital acquisition, year inferred from press page ordering; 2026, the National Law Review Best Law Firm Marketing Companies list. The press page also lists six Inc. 5000 appearances, a w3 Award and four Financial Times fastest growing listings; no news, case study text or job postings are on record.

Pricing: the free report, which the homepage notes other agencies charge up to $500 for; no price for its own work is shown, so P5 is unknown despite the outcome language. Conspicuously absent: any local line (Local scores 0), a headcount, and a described case study behind any named client.
clients:
The record describes a mid market client type, one US office in North Hollywood, CA, and six practice area verticals: Personal injury law, Criminal defense law, Mass tort law, Estate and probate law, Family law, and Consumer and class action law. All 8 client entries come from the case studies index and all 8 are names only, observed 0, so no need is read from evidence.

The names are Ben Crump, Top Class Actions, Law Offices of Adam Smallow, Simmrin Law Group, Sue The Collector, Bogin, Munns & Munns, CCK Law and Ambient Edge, and two of them, Top Class Actions and Law Offices of Adam Smallow, carry their own case study URLs with no title or text captured. The need for every one is inferred from the mix Hennessey Digital leads with: organic demand and AI visibility first, paid performance and lead generation behind, with support in the sold PPC pages for personal injury and criminal defense lawyers. No client sits on another tracked agency's book (shared_n 0), and no press release names an agency of record.

What the base needs next, read against KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation): firms that bought rankings are very likely, at moderate confidence, to ask for AI answer visibility next, and the incumbent has already moved its front door there. Read against KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out), the same firms are likely to press on price and proof, and 8 undescribed names beneath a $1B+ claim is where a rival asks what was delivered; with displacement read at 66.9, the base is roughly as likely to move for a lower price as for a better product.
house: Say and do: 3 of 3 tested lines are practised, integrity 100, no gaps flagged. AI Search / GEO is corroborated, it publishes an llms.txt and carries 12 AI-topic URLs; paid search is corroborated, the Transparency Center shows 12 of its own Google ads, 8 in the last 30 days (2 text, 6 image, 4 video), last shown 2026-09-27; publishing cadence is corroborated and dense, 140 of 497 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 194 in 365. No AI crawlers are blocked. The stack is WordPress with gtm, complianz and Dealfront Leadfeeder tags, the last also its ABM stack; no social pixels or test tools. LinkedIn shows 24+ company page ads and 0 thought leader ads, a floor because more result pages exist; one reads "Traditional search rewards rankings. AI search rewards trust, authority, and relevance", another invites firms at Business of Law in Scottsdale to a free growth review. No Meta or TikTok reading exists.

openings:
The strongest opening is price against a book that buys on it. Monsoon reads displacement at 66.9 with SEO (19) and AI Search / GEO (10) the most movable hours, and the record shows no public pricing model beneath a fire us pledge and a $1B+ claim. An offshore delivered rival pricing SEO and GEO line by line in public is likely, at moderate confidence, to take mid market firms from a book of 8 undescribed names; the falsifier is a published outcome price or a case study with numbers on hennessey.com.

The layer to lead with is what the record leaves unclaimed: no feed, schema or entity work (P2 absent) beneath a GEO front door, no local line (Local scores 0) for firms whose LinkedIn ads quote personal injury lawyer near me, and paid search with no first party data or measurement depth (P4 partial) and no assistant ad testing (P8 absent). The house is not the opening: 3 of 3 tested lines are practised, so a say/do attack is very unlikely to land. Contestable names: all 8, none having described work.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, reads next in late October 2026: search and other growth below 10% flags cannibalization, and above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind its GEO front door is built for.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, reads next in late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, reads in October 2026: output or outcome pricing announced at a top five holdco would move KJ6, the judgment it is most exposed to, and put a public number beside its fire us pledge.

I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, is a rolling indicator: the next milestone ($2B) and its timing, and pricing below $20 CPM, test the KJ2 tailwind on a paid search line that shows no assistant ad testing.
Follow up the 2025 Herringbone Digital acquisition for a rebrand, a pricing change or a leadership move, since the site still trades under the Hennessey Digital brand.
